failure_reason: Akamai Bot Manager blocked tiers (a) and (b) before any tree data could be gathered: curl_cffi (chrome124 impersonation) got HTTP 200 but only an Akamai JS behavioral-challenge shell (no real content); headless Playwright (with/without HTTP2) timed out/hung on both the homepage and a category page, a known Akamai anti-headless response. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome succeeded and was used to walk the tree (robots.txt has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow, only User-agent:* URL-pattern rules that do not cover category browsing). After roughly 20 successful category-page navigations, costco.com began returning 'Access Denied' (Akamai) on /synthetic-down-alternative.html and this was confirmed persistent on a second, unrelated URL (/memory-foam.html) immediately after. Per the first-block-stops-you rule, no further requests were made to costco.com. Rows below marked with a MANUAL REVIEW flag and qty=null are categories whose page/h1 was confirmed to exist (via an earlier successful load) but whose exact product count and/or full subcategory tree could not be retrieved before the block.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt checked first (no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow found, only generic URL-pattern rules under User-agent:*). Tier (a) HTTP+curl_cffi blocked by Akamai JS challenge. Tier (b) Playwright headless blocked (connection hang/timeout, both with and without HTTP2). Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome worked until an Akamai 'Access Denied' wall appeared after ~20 page loads; work stopped there per the hard block rule (status=partial). TREE: built from Costco's own 'Shop by Category' widgets and breadcrumbs on live-rendered pages (Home Decor, Bedding, Blankets & Throws, Comforters, Pillows, Bath) plus a raw-HTML fetch pass confirming h1/status=200 for Kitchen Linens & Towels, Window Treatments, Rugs, Throw & Decorative Pillows, and Storage & Organization (these five were not fully traversed for subcategories/qty before the block). QTY: read exact 'Showing X-Y of N' text on each live-rendered leaf page (never estimated/aggregated); rows without a confirmed count are qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag, never fabricated. EXCLUDED: Lamps/Lighting, Home & Decorative Accents, Mirrors, Candles & Candle Holders, Wall Art, Artificial Plants/Flowers/Trees, Wall Decor (no evidence of textile wall-hanging subcategory found before block), Mattresses, Bedroom Furniture, Fireplaces & Stoves, all Bath fixtures/vanities/toilets/faucets/showers/bathtubs/mirrors/lighting/skincare, Grocery, Optical, Services, Photo -- all out of scope per textile.md/storage.md boundary sections. 'Pillows' (Bedding's sleep-pillow subcategory, distinct from 'Throw & Decorative Pillows') classified MEDIUM confidence per textile.md Sec 4/22 reasoning (fabric-encased bedding accessory, sold under the site's own Bedding hierarchy alongside Mattress Toppers which textile.md explicitly includes) rather than HIGH, since a filled sleep-pillow insert is not unambiguously a pure textile product.
